rationale: C08 is an exceptionally strong template: it is the earlier partial termination of the very same Canadian meat-import restrictions, is expressly referenced by the child, and uses nearly identical recitals, statutory authority, operative sequence, TSUS-amendment machinery, and effective-date language. The child adapts C08 by terminating the remaining beef-and-veal restriction and deleting item 945.03 rather than the cattle, swine, and pork provisions. C14 and C22 also contain analogous termination-and-deletion structures, but neither approaches C08's same regulatory program and close language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Canada has now lifted those unjustifiable restrictions on meat imports from the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Canada has now lifted those unjustifiable restrictions on cattle imports from the United States
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts C08's factual predicate to the remaining meat restrictions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Section 255(b) of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 ... authorizes the President to terminate in whole or in part any proclamation made pursuant to Section 252
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Section 255(b) of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 ... authorizes the President to terminate in whole or in part any proclamation made pursuant to Section 252
shared_material.explanation: The same statutory termination recital appears in virtually identical language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I deem it necessary and appropriate to terminate the remaining restrictions ... specifically those imposing temporary quantitative limitations on ... certain beef and veal from Canada
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I deem it necessary and appropriate to terminate in part the restrictions ... specifically those imposing temporary quantitative limitations on ... certain cattle, swine and pork from Canada
shared_material.explanation: This is a direct product-specific adaptation of C08's central drafting formula.

shared_material.child_excerpt: 1) [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE]. is terminated. 2) Subpart B of part 2 of the Appendix to the TSUS is amended ... By deleting ... item 945.03.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: 1) So much of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] as proclaimed temporary quantitative limitations ... is terminated. 2) Subpart B of part 2 of the Appendix to the TSUS is amended ... By deleting items 945.01, 945.02, and 945.04.
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same operative sequence: terminate the applicable portion of the underlying proclamation, then conform the same TSUS subpart by deleting the affected heading language and items.

shared_material.child_excerpt: effective with respect to articles entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption after 12:01 a.m. EST, January 1, 1976
shared_material.parent_excerpt: effective with respect to articles entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption after 12:01 a.m., EDT, August 7, 1975
shared_material.explanation: The effective-date clause is reused almost verbatim with only the date and time-zone designation changed.
